candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout. Traces show every checkout 502 correlated with an upstream order 500, so the gateway failure originates in the order service's server error.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side logs and dependency metrics are absent, so the specific internal fault producing the 500 is not established.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s are fast (16-110ms) and each correlates with an order-service 500 on POST /v1/orders; gateway metrics show 16 502s on /v1/checkout with no dependency-operation series. Topology confirms gateway->order. Root cause is bounded to order-service HTTP 500; the underlying order-internal cause needs order logs.
